title: Diffusion-Guided Mask-Consistent Paired Mixing for Endoscopic Image Segmentation (MCPMix)
mechanism: For each real image, a synthetic counterpart is generated under the same mask; only appearance is mixed and supervision always uses the original mask, with annealing back to real data.
adaptation: Counterparts from the UnIACorN or ContourDiff generator (half-cut CSIR style); supervision stays the real mask so generator drift adds no label noise; anneal mix strength to zero by step 20k.
min_experiment: PF + paired mixing vs PF + plain synthetic using the same counterparts. Metric E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: gain over plain synthetic < +0.01.
evidence: R: Kvasir-SEG, PICCOLO, CVC-ClinicDB, private NPC-LES, ISIC 2017; state of the art claimed, abstract gives no numbers.

alt_notes.adaptation: Counterparts from the translation/ControlNet arms in target style; real masks keep labels clean even if the generator drifts; anneal to real by step 20k.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Paired mixing vs plain synthetic with the same counterparts on PF. Metric E1 relF1@2. Kill: < +0.01. About 6 GPU-h.
